definitions.explanation: A small adhesive strip with a pad used to cover minor wounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧{絆創膏|ばんそうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}った→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: I cut my finger so I put on a band-aid.

examples.japanese: {絆創膏|ばんそうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていますか→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦{靴擦|くつず}れ→靴擦れ：16948_kutsuzure⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{絆創膏|ばんそうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: To put a band-aid on a blister from shoes.

notes:
{絆創膏|ばんそうこう} is the standard generic term for adhesive bandages (like Band-Aids). The kanji are rarely written — katakana バンソウコウ or hiragana ばんそうこう are also common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {絆創膏|ばんそうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to put on a band-aid
- {絆創膏|ばんそうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦はがす→剥がす：00081_hagasu⟧: to peel off a band-aid
- {絆創膏|ばんそうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていますか→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: Do you have a band-aid?

REGIONAL VARIATIONS:
Japan is famously divided by what people call band-aids:
- ⟦バンドエイド→バンドエイド：noentry⟧: brand name, widely understood
- ⟦カットバン→カットバン：noentry⟧: used in some western regions
- ⟦サビオ→サビオ：noentry⟧: used in Hokkaido
- ⟦リバテープ→リバテープ：noentry⟧: used in Kyushu

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{包帯|ほうたい}→包帯：05385_houtai⟧: bandage (wrapped type)
- ⟦{傷薬|きずぐすり}→傷薬：28843_kizugusuri⟧: wound medicine/ointment
